slides.h: No time for a 24-episode commitment? Start with [[one movie night]].
slides.dek: Five films that work on anyone, anime fan or not.

slides.title: Spirited Away
slides.why: The consensus masterpiece. A bathhouse for spirits and not one wasted frame.

slides.title: Your Name
slides.why: Two strangers start swapping bodies across Japan. The twist lands every single time.

slides.title: A Silent Voice
slides.why: A former bully grows up and tries to make it right. Heavier than the others, and worth it.

slides.title: Princess Mononoke
slides.why: A war between forest and industry with no real villain anywhere in it.

slides.title: Suzume
slides.why: A road trip across Japan closing doors that end worlds. Gorgeous and fast.

slides.body: Which film made anime click for you? Send this to tonight's watch group.
